import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dirX = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dirY = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    
    static int gridSize, timeLimit, startX, startY;
    static String[] labGrid = new String[20];
    static String[] sciGrid = new String[20];
    static int[][][][][] memoTable = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
    static int[][] edgeCap = new int[250][250];
    static int[] parentArr = new int[250];
    static int[][] shortestDist = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] visitedArr = new int[20][20];
    
    static boolean inBounds(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < gridSize && y >= 0 && y < gridSize && 
               labGrid[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && labGrid[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }
    
    static void computeDistances() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                shortestDist[i][j] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
                visitedArr[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        shortestDist[startX][startY] = 0;
        visitedArr[startX][startY] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        qx.add(startX);
        qy.add(startY);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qx.poll();
            int y = qy.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dirX[k];
                int ny = y + dirY[k];
                if (inBounds(nx, ny) && visitedArr[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    shortestDist[nx][ny] = shortestDist[x][y] + 1;
                    visitedArr[nx][ny] = 1;
                    qx.add(nx);
                    qy.add(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean canReach(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int steps) {
        if (steps > timeLimit) return false;
        int res = memoTable[x0][y0][x1][y1][steps];
        if (res != -1) return res == 1;
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) {
            memoTable[x0][y0][x1][y1][steps] = (shortestDist[x0][y0] >= steps) ? 1 : 0;
            return memoTable[x0][y0][x1][y1][steps] == 1;
        }
        if (shortestDist[x0][y0] <= steps) {
            memoTable[x0][y0][x1][y1][steps] = 0;
            return false;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = x0 + dirX[k];
            int ny = y0 + dirY[k];
            if (inBounds(nx, ny) && canReach(nx, ny, x1, y1, steps + 1)) {
                memoTable[x0][y0][x1][y1][steps] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        memoTable[x0][y0][x1][y1][steps] = 0;
        return false;
    }
    
    static boolean bfsFlow(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(parentArr, -1);
        parentArr[source] = -2;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int i = source; i <= sink; ++i) {
                if (parentArr[i] == -1 && edgeCap[v][i] > 0) {
                    parentArr[i] = v;
                    q.add(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return parentArr[sink] != -1;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        gridSize = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        timeLimit = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            sciGrid[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            labGrid[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        
        List<int[]> points = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> labCaps = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> sciCaps = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
                if (sciGrid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                } else if (Character.isDigit(sciGrid[i].charAt(j))) {
                    points.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    labCaps.add(labGrid[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    sciCaps.add(sciGrid[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        int numPoints = points.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < 250; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(edgeCap[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < numPoints; ++i) {
            edgeCap[0][i + 1] = sciCaps.get(i);
            edgeCap[numPoints + 1 + i][2 * numPoints + 1] = labCaps.get(i);
        }
        
        computeDistances();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < 62; m++) {
                            memoTable[i][j][k][l][m] = -1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < numPoints; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < numPoints; ++j) {
                if (canReach(points.get(i)[0], points.get(i)[1], points.get(j)[0], points.get(j)[1], 0)) {
                    edgeCap[i + 1][numPoints + 1 + j] = 1000;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (bfsFlow(0, 2 * numPoints + 1)) {
            int sinkNode = 2 * numPoints + 1;
            int flowAmount = 1000000;
            while (parentArr[sinkNode] >= 0) {
                flowAmount = Math.min(flowAmount, edgeCap[parentArr[sinkNode]][sinkNode]);
                sinkNode = parentArr[sinkNode];
            }
            sinkNode = 2 * numPoints + 1;
            while (parentArr[sinkNode] >= 0) {
                edgeCap[parentArr[sinkNode]][sinkNode] -= flowAmount;
                edgeCap[sinkNode][parentArr[sinkNode]] += flowAmount;
                sinkNode = parentArr[sinkNode];
            }
            totalFlow += flowAmount;
        }
        
        System.out.println(totalFlow);
    }
}
